research_findings: The application lacked a rate limiting mechanism, exposing public server actions like joinWaitlist to automated abuse.
The upstash/ratelimit package is a standard choice in Next.js, and was successfully integrated.
features_improved: Secured joinWaitlist server action with a sliding window rate limiter.
new_features_added: Added a new reusable ratelimit client (src/lib/ratelimit.ts) using Upstash Redis.
Added a conditional Upstash Redis client setup to prevent application crash when environment variables are not set.
next_steps_for_next_run: Integrate rate limiting into auth endpoints (like sign up and reset password) to prevent brute-force attacks.
